semantic_spec.L01_first_use: mark absence of a nickname in OPI 2

form_selection_rationale: Meaning was specified before form selection.
A short CV operator is appropriate for a high-frequency grammatical particle and fits the dominant HNK phonotactic profile.
N and E are both governed safe transliteration units in HNK40.
No exact NE form was found in the current recovered/authored registry search.
The form is new authorship; no claim is made that historical HNK used NE for negation.

proposed_usage.scope: future test only; not automatically licensed by this proposal

promotion_gate: Human approval of NE as the v1.1 authored negation/absence primitive.
Canonical collision and HNK40 round-trip check in @hnk/linguas.
Register as authored CANDIDATE, never as recovered/FROZEN on first entry.
Approve each course usage separately until broader grammar is governed.
